area: POV follow-ups: the simulated POV build, the sample tenant's PRA credential pools and ZPA isolation profiles, browser tests of the Team server page and the sign-in screens, and the glass effect's drawing cost
title: Wave 10: every POV part simulates on the in-memory copy, more sample data, the sign-in screens tested in a browser, lighter glass on slow computers

coverage.how: each spec item mapped to tests: tests/test_rehearsal_simulation.py and tests/test_offline_tenant.py (item 1), tests/test_config_backup.py, tests/test_restore_breadth.py and tests/test_zpa_rbac.py (item 2), tests/test_team_login_browser.py (item 3), tests/test_glass_perf_browser.py and tests/test_glass.py (item 4)

checks.what: Every POV part (ZIA baseline with Cloud App Control, SSL certificates, ZPA connector group, app segments and policy rules, Client Connector profiles, ZDX probes, AI Guard routing and policy) applies to and reads back from the simulation of the sample and of a snapshot; the base is unchanged
The POV build simulation on a live tenant is refused with 409 before any client is built or socket opened; a snapshot still refuses a policy rule write

The sample backup holds PRA credential pools and ZPA isolation profiles with no secret-named field; restore remaps rules to the target's pool and profile by name; the PRA credential check sees the pool

Login and Team server page: keyboard sign-in, labels, help marks, 320px, light and dark AA contrast, SAML and passkey controls open to an administrator, locked when set by the environment, absent for a viewer, the passkey step after a password, no script errors

Glass on two CPUs (headless Chrome, no GPU): an idle page draws about one frame a second, reduced motion draws nothing at rest, in-flow surfaces drop their blur while scrolling and get it back after, scrolled drawing is at most ten times the glass-off cost

findings.title: A simulated POV build stopped at the ZIA baseline: Cloud App Control rules of different types got the same id on the copy, so the read-back compared the wrong rule
findings.fix: A Cloud App Control rule id is one number space across rule types on the offline tenant

findings.title: ZPA policy rules, Client Connector profiles, ZDX probes and ZIA settings could not be written to a simulation (no policy set, no edit routes)
findings.fix: The offline tenant answers policy sets, routes rule writes to the type's list, models the Client Connector edits, the ZDX configuration and settings PUTs

findings.title: A simulation of a snapshot answered URL lookups from the sample's table, so a plan rehearsed on the snapshot changed on its simulation (plan_changed)
findings.fix: A simulation answers a URL lookup as the tenant it copies did

findings.title: The Team server page's SAML form scrolled sideways by 70px at 320px (a grid item's minimum is its content: the file picker)
findings.fix: The form's grid items may shrink (min-width 0, minmax(0, 1fr)) and the file picker fits

findings.title: "Or type the identity provider's values" on the Team server page had no help entry or mark
Glass pages: the drift re-drew every blurred layer about fifteen times a second at rest, and every scrolled frame re-blurred every in-flow card (14 times the glass-off drawing time on two cores)
findings.fix: The drift steps once a second on both layers together; while scrolling, in-flow cards and chrome drop their blur and the drift holds
